procedures.title: Vehicle serial number: decode

specs.value: body style / model number (see model identification)
unit number, starting at 100,001 at every plant

notes: The manual's sample tag is 1 5645 8 F 100025 (F = Flint); a Corvette tag carries 194 37/67 as the body style.

procedures.title: Keys and locks
notes: Each car comes with four keys: two with hexagonal heads and two with round heads.
The hexagonal-head key fits the ignition switch and the front door locks.
The round-head key fits the glove box and rear compartment locks; on the Corvette it fits the spare tire compartment lid lock.

procedures.title: Pushing and towing: automatic transmission
steps: Do not try to start a car with an automatic transmission by pushing it.
If the battery is flat, start the engine with an auxiliary battery and jumper cables.
Connect positive to positive and negative to negative.
notes: Do not tow a car to start it: the disabled car may accelerate into the tow vehicle.
Caution: never use booster batteries totalling more than 12 volts, or the electrical system can be damaged.
